text_block_list.text:
On the way back from town, I spotted Ryoka Tsurugi.
She had stopped in front of an arcade,
peering closely inside.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
I was just wondering what kind of games are out these days.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: There might be a game that's perfect for a challenge video... maybe I should give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, Trainer, would you care to join us?

After strolling through the arcade for a while, Ryoka Tsurugi
unexpectedly stopped right in front of a gun shooting game.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the two of us could play this together.
I've never played this kind of machine before,
so I'm a bit nervous, but...
choice_data_list: It looks pretty scary, are you going to be alright?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I-I'll do my very best!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
A bolt-action rifle...
Quite a classic, understated build.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Whatever the case, let's go ahead and get started!

text_block_list.name: Creature
text_block_list.text: Grooooaaaar!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Eeeep!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. It just took me
so completely by surprise...

text_block_list.name: Creature
text_block_list.text: Grrr――
(Pop!)

The moment I aimed my weapon at the newly appeared enemy,
it had already been shot clean through.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I did it!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I was simply keeping an eye on where they were likely to appear... The prediction just happened to pan out.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
! Reinforcements incoming from the left!
Use the door for concealment and take cover!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Clearing the vanguard complete! Next target... distant flying enemy!

Saying that, she methodically shot down the pesky
flying enemies one after another with pinpoint accuracy.
choice_data_list: This is a blind playthrough... right?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But I often play multiplayer FPS games.
Something like this should be――
(BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: It's nothing of the sort!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
We've finally reached the final boss.
This is the critical moment!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Carefully... watch the timing...
Now! Concentrate all your firepower on a single point!
choice_data_list: Ugh... As expected, a formidable opponent!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Either way, let's keep shooting! We made it this far, so together we can definitely take it down!
However, the moment she prepared to strike the decisive blow, an attack from her blind spot ambushed Ryoka Tsurugi!

text_block_list.name: Boss Creature
text_block_list.text: BLUUUUUAAAAARGH!!!!
(Slash!)

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Wha! I... I've been had?!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
No, recovery appears improbable.
...However, the enemy's attention
remains fixed on us.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Use me as decoy and defeat the bo!

It looks like one final push could bring the boss down.
However, if we lose fighting strength here,
can we really achieve victory?
choice_data_list: Head to Ryoka Tsurugi to recover

text_block_list.name: Boss Creature
text_block_list.text: BLUUUUUAAAAARGH!!!
(WHOOOOSH!!)

The fired bullet pierces through the boss creature.
As it goes down, the words
"YOU SURVIVED" fill the entire screen.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer!
Good game!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your precise instructions, Ms. Tsurugi.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for
spending time with me today.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: That was so much fun! Next time, let's definitely aim to clear it with both of us surviving!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Please come play with me again sometime!

I rush over to Ryoka Tsurugi.
If we treat it right now, we should still make it in time.
choice_data_list: Here's a first-aid kit. I'd never abandon you!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, behind you!!

text_block_list.name: Boss Creature
text_block_list.text: BLUUUUUAAAAARGH!!!

A fatal blow from the boss pierces your back.
And then, filling the entire screen,
the words 'GAME OVER' appear...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
It's all because I collapsed...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Still, I had a lovely time today.
If you will excuse me.
